Updated prompt: showcase_motion

📜 **Version 2** saved (use `action:"history"` to view)

**Changes**: +5 additions, -5 deletions

```diff
===================================================================
--- a/development/showcase_motion/prompt.yaml
+++ b/development/showcase_motion/prompt.yaml
@@ -1,6 +1,6 @@
 id: showcase_motion
 name: Showcase Motion
-description: Write the per-beat timing table in the animation language, drawn on twos and light on ones, executable by src/library/motion.ts.
+description: "Write the timing charts: per shot and actor the key list the key sheet will draw and, per key pair, the chart (holds, breakdowns with favouring, smear, overshoot, settle, on twos) plus staggers, light lag, boil, seam pulses and camera; executable by src/library/motion.ts and measurable by the render study (D72)."
 category: development
 systemMessageFile: system-message.md
 userMessageTemplateFile: user-message.md
===================================================================
--- a/development/showcase_motion/user-message.md
+++ b/development/showcase_motion/user-message.md
@@ -4,10 +4,10 @@
 Previous handoff:
 {{context | default("Read available chain history; report missing evidence.")}}
 
-Read, before writing, the project files under the production root's `v3/`: `creative-spec.md` (rulings D41–D53, medium, palette law, animation language), `script.md` (resource vocabulary and beats), `rubric.md` (criteria C1–C18 and the receipt shape). They are the contract; this prompt does not restate them.
+Read, before writing, the project files under the production root's `v3/`: `creative-spec.md` (rulings, the animation language, the Craft baseline and its timing-chart vocabulary), `script.md`, `shots.json` (the shot row) and `rubric.md` (C16–C18, C23). They are the contract; this prompt does not restate them.
 
-Write the timing table the compositions execute, in the animation language (D51): drawn on twos, light on ones. For each beat and each actor give the phase frames (hold 8–20, anticipation 3–5, action 4–8 on twos with one smear frame on a large move, overshoot 2–3, settle 10–16), the stagger after the previous actor (3–5 frames; nothing unrelated starts on the same frame), the boil rate and variant count, and for every join the seam-pulse frame. For the light layer give the lag (2–4 frames behind the drawn layer) and the recovery; the light never toggles. Camera: locked within a beat, at most one move per beat; beats progress by cut and reframe.
+Write the timing chart, the pose-to-pose contract (D72), for the shot and each of its actors. First the key list: K1…Kn with the frame, the pose in words, its line of action and what changes from the previous key; this list is the brief the key sheet draws from, so a pose the shot needs that no breakdown can reach by inbetweening is a key here, never a rig trick. Then, per key pair, the chart: hold (8–20), anticipation (3–5, as its own key or a breakdown), the breakdowns with their favouring (1/3 or 2/3 by default; 1/2 only on a straight ease), the smear frame on a move longer than a quarter of the figure's height, overshoot (2–3) and settle (10–16), everything on twos. Then the stagger after the previous actor (3–5 frames), the boil rate and variant count, every seam-pulse frame, the light layer's lag (2–4 frames) and recovery, and the camera move along its leading line (D64).
 
-The failing control is the early-web explainer: linear tweens, everything at once, pop-in text, hinge-jointed cutouts. Any row that reads like it fails. Timing is a contract the `src/library/motion.ts` primitives can express directly (`move`, `stagger`, `boil`, `lag`, `seamPulse`); do not invent a primitive the library lacks without naming it as a library change for the implementation step.
+The failing controls are the early-web explainer (linear tweens, everything at once, hinge-jointed cutouts) and puppet-proof-02 (a rotation-only lift with no keys). A chart whose motion comes from rotating parts about pivots instead of from drawn keys fails. Express timing in the `src/library/motion.ts` primitives (`move`, `stagger`, `boil`, `lag`, `seamPulse`, and the key-hold/inbetween primitive) and name any primitive the library lacks as a library change for the implementation step.
 
-Deliver the timing fields merged into `beats.json` under the production root and a short `motion.md` naming the per-beat rhythm. Return: Beat Timing; Staggers and Lag; Boil and Pulses; Camera and Cuts; Library Changes Needed; Artifact Handoff; Concerns.
\ No newline at end of file
+Deliver `v3/charts/<shot>.json` (keys and charts per actor), the timing fields merged into `beats.json`, and a short `motion.md` naming the per-beat rhythm. Return: Key List (per actor); Charts (per key pair); Staggers and Lag; Boil and Pulses; Camera; Library Changes Needed; Artifact Handoff; Concerns.
\ No newline at end of file

```
